# Podlevskikh Automation — rescue for broken Zapier, Make and n8n

> A senior Python engineer who fixes broken automations in 48–72 hours: Zapier Zaps, Make scenarios and n8n workflows that silently stopped, duplicate records, failed webhooks, exhausted API quotas. Also builds custom scraping, AI/LLM workflows and integrations from scratch. Run by Vladimir Podlevskikh (MSU physicist, 20+ years building software and teaching).

- [Homepage and intake](https://auto.podlevskikh.com/)

## What gets fixed
- Zapier / Make / n8n automations that stopped firing or fire twice.
- Webhook chains that lose data between services.
- API integrations broken by a provider's change or rate limits.
- Scraping pipelines that died when the target site changed.
- Custom AI/LLM workflows: extraction, classification, drafting, routing.

## How it works
Describe the broken flow, get a diagnosis of the actual cause, then a fix delivered within 48–72 hours. Work is done directly in your account or in code you keep.
